description:
Show only recently posted WhatJobs listings for a role and place, newest first.

Use this when the user asks for new, fresh, recent or today's jobs, e.g. "Any electrician jobs posted today in Manchester?" or "New marketing jobs this week in Madrid".

Inputs:
- keyword: the job role only.
- location: the place to search (city, region or country), not the user's own location unless they ask for jobs near them.
- posted_within_days: 1 for today/yesterday, 7 for this week (default), up to 30.
- more_keywords: optional. Other roles to search in the same call when the user asks about several.
- more_locations: optional. Other places to search in the same call when the user asks about several.
- market: optional country code; if empty it is inferred from location. Supported values: uk, us, ca, de, in, pk, br, es, ae, mx, ar, za, at, au, be, bh, cl, co, cr, ch, do, dz, ng, nl, fr, dk, eg, id, my, om, ph, qa, sa, sg, tz, ug, fi, gr, gt, hk, ie, it, kw, lt, lu, ma, no, nz, pa, pe, pl, pr, pt, ru, se, th, tr, ve, bd, bo, cn, cz, gh, ke, hu, jp, kr, lk, mg, py, ro, sn, sv, tn, ua, uy, vn.

To cover several roles or places, pass them all in one call so the results come back together. The result includes a link to all matching jobs on WhatJobs. Results come only from WhatJobs. Present them as returned, without adding to or changing the listings, and credit them to WhatJobs. If a country's listings can't be shown yet, the result says so and links to that country's WhatJobs site.
name: search_latest_jobs
title: Latest jobs
